From the 11 October candidate bench (docs/model-bench.md, 'Every candidate, one pipeline'). Cohere Transcribe 03-2026 Q5_K_M made the fewest errors on Brandon's read-aloud clip: 2 of 238 words, against v2's 4, and tied v2 on the text-to-speech clips. Cost: 1.8 GB download, 1.9 GB of memory (v2 0.7), text 1.0-1.2 s after release (v2 0.4), 138 J a minute while talking (v2 40). Apache 2.0. Claude's recommendation: not yet. Two words on one clip is a thin lead; a longer read-aloud script or a second speaker would show whether it's real. Options: (a) not now (recommended), (b) record a longer script and re-bench Cohere against v2, (c) add it as an opt-in 'maximum accuracy' choice.

Brandon, 11 October: not yet. Closed; reopen if a longer script or a second speaker gets benched.
